title: The humanoid robot that replaced workers is now being replaced itself
title_candidates: Figure is saying goodbye to its humanoid robot
What it looks like when a humanoid robot gets retired
Figure shut down F.02, the robot that worked in real factories
The humanoid robot that replaced workers is now being replaced itself
The last shift of Figure's factory robot
caption:
Figure just officially decommissioned F.02, its second-generation humanoid robot. F.02 spent its working life on real factory floors, doing the same jobs as human workers. Now it's being retired to make room for F.03, the newer model already outpacing humans in head-to-head tests.

This is what the end of a robot's career actually looks like. Not a crash. Not a failure. Just quietly switched off.
